meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后，每当 apply_patch、write、edit 等改动类操作成功，插件会自动检查代码注释；若发现问题会给出阻断性反馈，Claude 需先修正或说明被标记的注释再继续。不提供 MCP 工具。
howto.when: 当 Codex 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等改动类工具调用后触发；非改动类工具会被忽略，缺少检查器程序时不会输出任何提示。

say.text: 先处理刚才 comment-checker 的警告再继续。
say.note: Claude 会修正或说明被标记的注释。

say.text: 解释一下这次被标记的注释问题出在哪。
say.note: Claude 会说明警告针对的具体注释。

say.text: 改完这个文件后，再看看注释有没有被标记。
say.note: 改动成功后会再次触发注释检查。

howto.what_en: Once installed, after successful apply_patch, write, edit and similar calls the plugin checks comments; if comment-checker warns, Codex gets blocking feedback and should fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggers after Codex successfully runs edit-like tool calls such as apply_patch, write, edit; non-edit tools are ignored, and a missing checker binary produces no hook output.

say_en.text: Fix or explain the flag from the last comment-checker warning.
say_en.note: Codex addresses the flagged comment before continuing.

say_en.text: After this edit, check again for comment warnings.
say_en.note: The hook runs again after the edit.
